MIDS-001.title: Invalid dataset path
MIDS-001.description: The supplied dataset path must exist, be readable, and be a directory.

next_step.text: Provide the path to an existing readable MIDS dataset directory.

MIDS-002.title: Unexpected item in dataset root
MIDS-002.description: The dataset root may contain only subject directories named `sub-<ID>` and `participants.tsv`.

next_step.text: Move the affected root items outside the MIDS dataset or organize them within the appropriate subject directory.

MIDS-003.title: Invalid subject identifier
MIDS-003.description: Subject directories must follow `sub-<ID>`, where `<ID>` contains only accepted alphanumeric characters.

next_step.text: Rename the subject directory and corresponding file identifiers to a valid `sub-<ID>`.

MIDS-004.title: Invalid session identifier
MIDS-004.description: Session directories, when present, must follow `ses-<ID>`, where `<ID>` contains only accepted alphanumeric characters.

next_step.text: Rename the session directory and corresponding file identifiers to a valid `ses-<ID>`.

MIDS-005.title: Mixed session and direct-datatype structure
MIDS-005.description: Within one subject, imaging data must either be stored inside `ses-<ID>` session directories or directly inside datatype directories. The two layouts cannot be mixed for the same subject.

next_step.text: Choose one layout for the subject: place all imaging data inside session directories, or place all datatype directories directly inside the subject directory.

MIDS-006.title: Unrecognized datatype item
MIDS-006.description: Items at the imaging-data level must be supported datatype directories: `mr-anat`, `mr-quant`, `ct`, or `rx`.

next_step.text: Move the affected item into the appropriate supported datatype directory, or move it outside the MIDS dataset.

MIDS-007.title: Empty datatype directory
MIDS-007.description: A recognized datatype directory contains no image data.

next_step.text: Determine whether the directory represents an incomplete conversion or an unused datatype directory.

MIDS-008.title: Subject contains no recognized imaging data
MIDS-008.description: A subject directory contains no images in recognized datatype directories.

next_step.text: Determine whether imaging data are missing, stored in an unsupported location, or intentionally absent for this subject.

MIDS-009.title: Operating-system artifact present
MIDS-009.description: A common operating-system artifact is present in the dataset. The most common example is `.DS_Store`, which macOS creates automatically.

next_step.text: Remove the reported operating-system artifact before sharing the dataset.

MIDS-101.title: Unsupported item in datatype directory
MIDS-101.description: Datatype directories may contain only recognized finished image files and their metadata sidecars.

next_step.text: Move the unsupported item outside the datatype directory or convert it to a supported dataset file.

MIDS-102.title: Filename subject identifier mismatch
MIDS-102.description: Every supported image and JSON filename must contain a subject identifier matching its containing subject directory.

next_step.text: Correct the filename subject identifier so it matches the containing subject directory.

MIDS-103.title: Recognized suffix in wrong datatype directory
MIDS-103.description: A recognized acquisition suffix must be stored in its associated datatype directory.

next_step.text: Move the affected image and its sidecars to the datatype directory associated with the recognized suffix.

MIDS-104.title: Case-conflicting filename
MIDS-104.description: Two filenames in the same datatype directory differ only by capitalization.

next_step.text: Resolve the case-conflicting filenames so they remain distinct and portable across filesystems.

MIDS-201.title: Missing primary JSON sidecar
MIDS-201.description: Every NIfTI image requires a matching primary JSON sidecar in the same datatype directory.

next_step.text: Reconvert the source DICOM data with dcm2omids to regenerate the NIfTI images and their primary JSON sidecars.

MIDS-202.title: Malformed primary JSON sidecar
MIDS-202.description: A primary JSON sidecar must contain syntactically valid, readable UTF-8 JSON.

next_step.text: Regenerate the affected primary sidecar from the source DICOM data with dcm2omids, or correct the reported JSON problem.

MIDS-203.title: Malformed optional JSON sidecar
MIDS-203.description: A present patient or extra JSON sidecar must contain syntactically valid, readable UTF-8 JSON.

next_step.text: Regenerate the affected optional sidecar from the source DICOM data with dcm2omids.

MIDS-204.title: Optional patient JSON sidecar is absent

next_step.text: No action is required unless patient-sidecar metadata are needed for the intended use.

MIDS-205.title: Optional extra JSON sidecar is absent

next_step.text: No action is required unless extra-sidecar metadata are needed for the intended use.

MIDS-206.title: Orphan JSON sidecar
MIDS-206.description: A primary, patient, or extra JSON sidecar exists without a corresponding NIfTI image.

next_step.text: Determine whether the corresponding image is missing or the orphan sidecar no longer belongs in the dataset.

MIDS-207.title: Invalid extra JSON structure
MIDS-207.description: An extra JSON sidecar must contain exactly the expected meta and extra top-level structures.

next_step.text: Regenerate the affected extra sidecar with dcm2omids or correct its top-level structure.

MIDS-301.title: Mandatory metadata field is missing
MIDS-301.description: A metadata field classified as mandatory for the recognized acquisition profile is absent from the primary JSON sidecar.

next_step.text: Recover the reported field from the source acquisition metadata or study records where available.

MIDS-302.title: Metadata field has an invalid type
MIDS-302.description: A recognized metadata field is present but cannot be interpreted using its verified expected type.

next_step.text: This rule is deferred until representative output and expected JSON types are verified.

MIDS-303.title: Mandatory metadata field is empty
MIDS-303.description: A mandatory metadata field is present but contains no usable value.

next_step.text: Recover the reported value from the source acquisition metadata or study records where available.

MIDS-304.title: Optional metadata field is missing
MIDS-304.description: A metadata field classified as optional for the recognized acquisition profile is absent from the primary JSON sidecar.

next_step.text: No action is required unless the optional field is needed for the intended analysis or reuse.

MIDS-401.title: Unreadable or invalid NIfTI file
MIDS-401.description: The image cannot be opened and interpreted as a NIfTI file.

next_step.text: Reconvert the affected source imaging data with dcm2omids or replace the unreadable NIfTI file from an authoritative source.

MIDS-402.title: Acquisition dimension outlier
MIDS-402.description: An image's dimensions differ from the common shape for the same image type across the dataset.

next_step.text: Compare the affected image with the expected acquisition dimensions and determine whether the difference is intentional.

MIDS-501.title: Conflicting participants table filenames
MIDS-501.description: The dataset contains exact `participants.tsv` and one or more filenames that differ from it only by capitalization.

next_step.text: Resolve the conflicting participants-table files and retain one authoritative exactly named `participants.tsv`.

MIDS-502.title: Participants table is invalid
MIDS-502.description: `participants.tsv` must be valid tab-separated data with one coherent `participant_id` key per row.

next_step.text: Correct the reported table structure, participant identifier, or row-level problem.

MIDS-503.title: Participant inventory mismatch
MIDS-503.description: The subject directories and `participant_id` values do not describe the same subject set.

next_step.text: Use `--participants` to add subject directories missing from the table; review participant rows that have no corresponding subject directory.

MIDS-504.title: Participants table is absent
MIDS-504.description: The dataset does not contain a root-level file named exactly `participants.tsv`.

next_step.text: Create or populate `participants.tsv` from the subject-directory inventory.

MIDS-505.title: Patient age differs within an imaging session
MIDS-505.description: Within one imaging session for a subject, all non-empty string `Age` values in readable patient JSON sidecars must be identical. A subject without explicit session directories is treated as having one imaging session. Missing age values do not trigger this rule.

next_step.text: Review the conflicting age values against the acquisition dates and appropriate source records.

MIDS-506.title: Patient sex differs within a subject
MIDS-506.description: Across all imaging sessions for a subject, non-empty string `Sex` values in readable patient JSON sidecars are expected to be identical. Missing sex values do not trigger this rule.

next_step.text: Review the differing values in the study context. Patient sex metadata may legitimately change or be corrected over time; this informational finding helps distinguish an intended update from a coding or conversion error and must not be used to overwrite values automatically.
